notes.title: Backrooms Level X will be in the Horror Game Awards Summer Showcase!
notes.content:
The eerie world of [b]Backrooms Level X[/b] with endless mazes and terrifying entities will be present at the [b]Horror Game Awards Summer Showcase[/b], which will take place on May 31st at 11AM PDT / 2PM EDT / 7PM BST!

Tune in and watch the stream on the [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@HorrorGameAwards/streams]YouTube[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/horrorgameawards]Twitch[/url][/b] channels of The Horror Game Awards if you want to see more of Backrooms Level X and many other world premieres and amazing horror games!

And while you’re at it, remember that Backrooms Level X has just launched on Steam and currently has a huge [b]launch discount of 20%[/b]. If you like what you see on the showcase, don’t miss out on the chance of getting it now.

You can also check the event’s Steam page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45104824/sale/HorrorGameAwardsSummerShowcase][b]here[/b][/url]. We hope you enjoy the showcase, see you on the stream!

notes.title: Enter the unknown world of Backrooms Level X, out now!
notes.content:
[b]Backrooms Level X[/b], the first-person survival horror inspired by the Backrooms universe, is out now on Steam! What’s more, it arrives with a tempting [b]20% launch discount[/b].

[previewyoutube=K8TauqUdnng;full][/previewyoutube]
Investigate a strange incident that took place in the 80s and was recorded on a VHS tape, and enter a world of liminal spaces and endless corridors that will feel like a giant maze, and face the mysterious and gigantic entities lurking in the shadows. If you think you’re prepared to survive in the [b]13 haunting and atmospheric levels[/b] filled with horror and mystery, solve the [b]challenging puzzles[/b] you’ll find in them, and if you’re brave enough to withstand its oppressive atmosphere and sound design, it’s time to start playing!

And don’t worry, for those of you who would like to experience this surreal adventure on consoles, the game is coming very soon to [b]Xbox[/b], [b]PlayStation[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] too! You can follow us on social media to stay updated with all the news.

We hope you have a good time losing yourself inside the backrooms!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303230/Backrooms_Level_X/

notes.title: Backrooms Level X: Unveil the Unknown, Debuting Today at Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Backrooms Level X, the game set to transform the world of horror exploration, launches its demo today at 19:00 (GMT+2) at the Steam Next Fest. Known for highlighting the most innovative titles, this event will now showcase Backrooms Level X, a game that dives into the eerie unknown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/da4bfb82b9f67b57872c860164c7c0f9b912b8d1.jpg[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]

[b]Immersive Exploration:[/b] Navigate an environment crafted with unique level design. Uncover hidden secrets and become engrossed in a narrative that draws you deep into the story.

[b]Atmospheric Horror:[/b] Immerse yourself in an oppressive atmosphere with haunting sound effects and chilling graphics that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

[b]Challenges and Puzzles:[/b] Solve riddles and face challenges that test your wits as you strive to escape from the Backrooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/7bc282c05e2dd7687cdc4f7b55e10d02500553d0.jpg[/img]

[b]Varied Environments:[/b] Backrooms Level X comprises more than 13 levels to explore. Delve into the intricacies of the story and enemies, ensuring each gameplay experience is fresh and exhilarating.

[b]Defiant Bosses:[/b] Emerge unscathed from encounters with gigantic final enemies. Throughout your exploration, confront massive bosses that you must defeat with cunning and strategy.

Prepare for a horror experience like no other with Backrooms Level X at the Steam Next Fest. Are you ready to unveil the unknown and confront your deepest fears? Join us today at 19:00 (GMT+2) and see what horrors await in the shadows.

notes.title: Backrooms Level X: Preview Demo
notes.content:
Discover the new Demo of Backrooms Level X.

Enter the eerie world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and surreal spaces. After a freak accident, you find yourself trapped in the Backrooms, a place where logic and reality vanish. Explore endless corridors of yellow carpet, empty rooms and areas of flickering light as you try to find a way out. But beware: you are not alone. Mysterious entities lurk in the shadows, and every sound may be the last you hear.

Features:

Immersive Exploration: Navigate an immersive environment made with unique level design. Discover hidden secrets and an immersive narrative that will draw you into the story.

Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in an oppressive atmosphere with immersive sound effects and haunting graphics that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Challenges and Puzzles: Solve riddles and face challenges that will test your wits as you try to escape from the Backrooms.

Varied Environments: Backrooms Level X consists of more than 13 levels to explore. Discover the intricacies of the story and enemies, keeping each game a fresh and exciting experience.

Defiant Bosses: Get out unscathed from huge final enemies. Throughout the exploration, we will encounter gigantic bosses that we will have to defeat with our wits.

Do you have what it takes to survive in the Backrooms?

notes.title: Thrilling PC Demo Now Available for Survival Horror Game Backrooms Level X
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/501e6bc58e9977499e4d9751fbe08396cad47ccb.jpg[/img]

Hi all,

We want to invite you to venture into the dark and terrifying world of the Backrooms Level X with the launch of a thrilling free PC demo. Backrooms Level X is a first-person narrative survival horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and liminal spaces. Navigate through dark, atmospheric levels where terrifying entities lurk in the shadows, and challenging puzzles stand between freedom or your untimely demise. 

Available to download from Steam now, this specially created prologue demo transports you to a few years before the strange incident of the main game in 1986. Navigate the endless labyrinth of the Backrooms, solving puzzles that might assist you in your quest to escape. But beware, as a special guest awaits you in the shadows. Friend or foe? Only time will tell as you unlock the mysteries lurking around every corner and strive to survive the mysterious liminal space. 

Watch the Backrooms Level X PC demo trailer here:

[previewyoutube=4fdM-IiiEYg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NPC Character Upgrades Coming Soon to Backrooms Level X!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that NPC character upgrades are currently in development for Backrooms Level X! Soon, the non-playable characters in the game will receive a new art style that will make them even more attractive. These improvements are designed to enhance the gameplay experience, making your encounters with NPCs more intense and engaging.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/1c881fff033caea1bbbd66992b08f587125cad0b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/0531a15d1c27573349b7fb6f54e863501da481e0.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/1fb1a364de573f65e7e18b350c1bab7d34b6f6e9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433878/ce2e177007ab91e907bc16725bd1eb723b4c2416.jpg[/img][/url]

We want to take a moment to thank our community for your patience and support as we continue to work on these upgrades. Your feedback mean the world to us, and we can't wait to share the enhanced Backrooms experience with you!

Stay tuned for more updates—these upgraded NPCs will bring a whole new level of quality and thrill to the Backrooms!
